versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations And Information
versions.text:
(a) The rotorcraft must contain:
  (1) The markings and placards specified in CS 29.1545 to 29.1565; and
  (2) Any additional information, instrument m arkings, a nd placards required for the safe o peration o f th e rotorcraft if it has unusual desi gn, operat ing or handling characteristics.
(b) Each m arking and placard prescribed in sub-paragraph (a):
  (1) Must be di splayed i n a conspi cuous place; and
  (2) May not be easily erased, disfigured, or obscured.
